item.title: Villi, Low-Protein Cytolysis, and Silicone Gels — Veterinary GI Endoscopy, Corn-Oil Lacteals & Feline Ileal Lymphoma (V036), CSF Lumbar Flow, 30-Min Lysis & Neuro-FIP Cure (V037) & Vet TDM, SST Gel Traps & Feline KBr Asthma Ban (V038)
item.description: One Medicine synthesis of veterinary GI endoscopy (V036), CSF analysis (V037), and veterinary TDM (V038): left lateral positioning, Fleet enema ban, corn-oil lacteals, and feline ileal-only T-cell lymphoma (18-39%); pre-tap MRI, lumbar vs. cisternal CSF, 30-60m oncotic lysis rescue (10% serum/Hetastarch), SRMA IgA, GS-441524 neuro-FIP cure, and equine EPM SAG ratios; and plain red-top vs. SST phenobarbital trap, feline KBr/diazepam bans, KBr chloride kinetics, cyclosporine IL-2 mRNA PD, and feline methimazole CKD unmasking.

item.title: Tears, Stria Melanocytes, and Spinal Arcs — Veterinary Ophthalmic Exam, Descemetocele 'Donut Hole' & TonoVet Physics (V033), BAER Deafness Screening, MITF/PMEL Stria Collapse & Cavalier PSOM (V034) & Neurologic Localization, Schiff-Sherrington & the Deep Pain Law (V035)
item.description: One Medicine synthesis of veterinary ophthalmology/tonometry (V033), BAER deafness screening (V034), and neurologic localization (V035): STT-I sequence, cherry-eye gland preservation, descemetocele fluorescein 'donut hole', collar/species TonoVet traps, and fellow-eye glaucoma prophylaxis; Strain's >12,000 Dalmatian registry, MITF/KIT stria melanocytes, OFA >=35d rule, and Cavalier PSOM bone BAER; and 4 spinal segments, Schiff-Sherrington, paradoxical vestibular tilt, and Olby's Deep Pain & Progressive Myelomalacia laws.

item.title: Photons, Thresholds, and Tracers — Mammography, Tomosynthesis & Dense-Breast Screening (H036), DXA Bone Density, Spondylosis Artifacts & NORA/SCOOP Paradoxes (H037) & Nuclear Medicine SPECT/PET-CT Theranostics (H038)
item.description: Clinical Cluster & Diagnostic Physics synthesis of mammography/DBT (H036), DXA bone densitometry (H037), and nuclear medicine SPECT/PET-CT (H038): Friedewald DBT (n=454,850), DENSE MRI (n=40,373), BI-RADS discordance, and 1,000-woman screening funnels; DXA spondylosis false elevation, LSC math, NORA (n=200,160) & SCOOP (n=12,483), and pre-drug osteomalacia screening; and FDG superscans, proPSMA (n=302), SPECT balanced ischemia vs. PET CFR, cold myeloma vs. flare, PIOPED II V/Q, I-131 fetal thyroid protection, and Deauville 1-5.

item.title: Shadows, Sound, and Spin — Human Musculoskeletal Radiography & Occult Fractures (H031), Veterinary Allometric Echocardiography & EPIC/TMT Cohorts (V015) & Brain/Spinal Neuro-MRI (V017)
item.description: One Medicine synthesis of human musculoskeletal radiography (H031), veterinary echocardiography (V015), and veterinary neuro-MRI (V017): Ottawa rules, occult scaphoid/hip cohorts, 10-14 day osteomyelitis lag, and 21-view forensic surveys; allometric cardiac scaling (BW^0.294), EPIC (n=360), feline Transient Myocardial Thickening (n=21), and Doppler 4V^2 math; and Ito's 71-dog myelomalacia prognostic rule, post-ictal piriform mimics, dorsal microchip voids, and pre-CSF herniation checks.

item.title: The Potassium That Rose in the Tube — Reverse Pseudohyperkalemia in Leukocytosis, Pneumatic Tube Shear vs. Hand-Carried Whole Blood, Cold-Induced ABCB6 Leak & ECG Sensitivity Traps
item.description: Dissecting in-vitro potassium artifacts before the analyzer: Mansoor et al. (2015) reverse pseudohyperkalemia (9.5 mmol/L across three analyzers vs. 3.7 mmol/L on hand-carried whole blood due to pneumatic-tube mechanical lysis of fragile leukemic white cells in heparinized plasma), Xiong et al. (2022) familial cold-induced ABCB6 red-cell potassium leak, and Raffee et al. (2022) why a normal ECG cannot rule out true hyperkalemia.

item.title: What the Surface Sample Missed — Cervical Cytology & Self-Collected HPV Trials (H028), Canine & Feline Tissue Biopsy Margins (V019) & Deep vs. Surface Skin Scrapings (V032)
item.description: One Medicine epithelial, mucosal, and surgical pathology deep dive (H028, V019, V032): ASCCP unsatisfactory vs. absent-TZ rules, 2025 SELF-CERV vaginal HPV trial (n=599), HPV FOCAL (n=19,009), European pooled RCTs (n=176,464), English HPV vaccine registry (13.7M person-years), gastric-type adenocarcinoma missed by cone biopsy, Kemp (2015) 70-dog liver biopsy concordance (60%-69%), Marsilio (2019) 12/20 healthy cats called small-cell lymphoma on IHC/PARR, 2026 32-dog STS biopsy undergrading, 94-dog STS 3-year margin recurrence (41.2%/22.5%/7.1%), Barillas (2019) demodicosis hair-pluck vs. deep-scrape monitoring, Díaz (2023) post-cure Malassezia qPCR persistence, and Bizikova (2019) 35-cat pemphigus foliaceus relapses (24/31).

item.title: Proviral Hiding Places & Shedding Windows — Feline Leukemia p27 Antigen, FIV Maternal Antibodies & Canine Parvovirus SNAP Traps
item.description: Clinical problem cluster in veterinary virology & Bayesian screening (V027, V028, V001): Feline Leukemia Virus (FeLV) soluble p27 capsid antigen ELISA vs. IFA & quantitative proviral DNA/RNA PCR across abortive, regressive (occult bone-marrow integration transmitted via blood transfusion!), and progressive stages; FIV gp40/p24 antibody testing vs. colostral maternal antibodies in kittens <6 months & vaccine interference; low-prevalence positive predictive value (PPV) math requiring orthogonal confirmation; paired with Canine Parvovirus (CPV-2a/2b/2c) fecal antigen ELISA false negatives (dilution, mucosal antibody sequestration, narrow shedding window) vs. PCR post-MLV vaccine false positives.

item.title: Cells on a Glass Slide Before the Scalpel — Fine-Needle Aspiration Cytology, Mesenchymal Silence, Mast Cell Granules & Biopsy Truth
item.description: One Medicine cytopathology deep dive (V018): 2026 AAHA oncology FNA staging, Romanowsky vs. Papanicolaou staining & formalin-fume artifacts, Whitlock lymph-node suction vs. capillary RCT, Ghisleni 292-mass concordance study (16.8% non-diagnostic exclusion & 68.7% NPV from non-exfoliating mesenchymal sarcomas), feline mediastinal Histoplasma mimicking heart-base neoplasia, canine intramuscular mast cell tumors, 2025 OPWG nodal lymphoma cytology vs. flow cytometry & PARR clonality, bone (83% accuracy vs. 50% cell-type), hepatic architecture limits, ex vivo splenic FNA/core 72% ceiling, pancreatic yield vs. confirmation, scar aspiration, and forensic chain of custody.

item.title: Leaky Glomeruli & Morning Ratios — Urine Albumin-to-Creatinine, Canine UPC, Orthostatic Veins & 30% Daily Noise
item.description: One Medicine comparative renal deep dive (H012, V002, V007): spot urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (uACR) dilution math, Cirillo sarcopenia low-creatinine denominator fallacy, Waikar >30% within-subject biological CV_I and RCV math, congenital IVC interruption causing extreme orthostatic proteinuria (3 to 4,131 mg/g), adult minimal-change nephrotic surge, Leung myeloma cast nephropathy light-chain blind spot, DAPA-CKD & EMPA-KIDNEY outcome statistics, paired with canine/feline IRIS Urine Protein-to-Creatinine (UPC) staging, active sediment traps, and serial pooled urine testing.

item.title: The Drug That Quieted the First Wave — Ondansetron & Cisplatin Emesis, 5-HT3A Cryo-EM (PDB 6W1M), Acute 5-HT3 vs. Delayed Substance P/NK1 Phase, hERG QTc Risk & CYP2D6 CPIC

item.title: The Breath Before the Heat — Rising End-Tidal CO2 Before Hyperthermia, Skeletal Muscle RyR1 Calcium Leak, Dantrolene Channel Stabilization & Post-Crisis IVCT/CHCT vs. RYR1 Genetic Testing
item.description: Intraoperative malignant hyperthermia from capnography to channel biophysics: why rising end-tidal carbon dioxide precedes core temperature elevation, uncontrolled skeletal muscle ryanodine receptor (RyR1) sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release, dantrolene sodium stabilization of RyR1, and post-crisis workup integrating RYR1 variant sequencing with caffeine-halothane contracture testing.

item.title: The Sugar That Stayed in the Scan — [18F]FDG from 1976–1979 Brain Autoradiography (Sokoloff & Reivich) and Cyclotron 109.77-Min Decay to GLUT3/Hexokinase II Trapping (4ZW9/2NZT), Thoracic SUVmax 7.2 & EBUS Granulomas

item.title: The Drug That Cut the Drug — Glucarpidase Methotrexate Rescue, DAMPA Immunoassay Cross-Reactivity vs. HPLC/LC-MS/MS (5.79 vs. 2.27 µmol/L at Hour 117, Gulley 2020), Ogawa Tissue Rebound & Organ Recovery
item.description: Enzymatic drug cleavage and analytical cross-reactivity after high-dose methotrexate rescue with glucarpidase (carboxypeptidase G2): Gulley et al.'s (2020) split specimen 74 hours post-glucarpidase reading 5.79 µmol/L by immunoassay vs. 2.27 µmol/L by HPLC due to DAMPA metabolite persistence beyond the nominal 48-hour VORAXAZE label window, Ogawa et al.'s (2024) 98.83% 20-minute plasma drop and tissue rebound, and Corbisier et al.'s (2024) multimodal pediatric liver/renal recovery.

item.description: Biochemical basis and diagnostic specificity of [18F]FDG-PET (H022): Sokoloff et al.'s (1977) hexokinase metabolic trapping of 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate, Reivich & Phelps's (1979) human positron emission tomography translation, Som et al.'s (1980) oncologic uptake, and Kubota et al.'s (1992) cellular microautoradiography proving why activated macrophages and granulation tissue generate intense FDG avidity indistinguishable from cancer on a single SUV number.

item.title: What the Section and the Scatter Saw — Tissue Biopsy, Cold Ischemia & Margin Geometry (H029), Flow Cytometry Clonality, MRD & Lineage Switch (H030) & Veterinary Helical CT Staging (V016)

item.title: The Piece the Camera Couldn't See — Normal-Appearing Mucosa in Eosinophilic Esophagitis (169 Eos/HPF, H047), Canine Pseudotumoral Bacterial Gastritis (V036) & Multilevel GI Biopsy Architecture
